literal: Only to virtue love is a support, they say, those who do not know; even to valor, that itself is the support.
translation: The ignorant say that love is a support only for virtue; but indeed, it is also the driving support for valor and overcoming hostility.
modern: அன்பு அறத்திற்கு மட்டுமே சார்பு என்று அறிவில்லாதவர்கள் கூறுவார்கள்; வீரத்திற்கும் தீமையை எதிர்ப்பதற்கும் கூட அதுவே துணையாக இருக்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet corrects a common misconception about the scope of love. Ignorant people believe that love is only useful for gentle, virtuous deeds. However, love is also the driving force behind valor or hostility, as one fights fiercely or opposes evil out of deep love for their family, country, or ideals. Thus, love serves as the ultimate foundation for both peaceful virtue and courageous action.
